donor_ecology_assignment: exactly half the problems per prefix dose in each ecology, random order in consecutive 8-problem blocks independently per world root
receiver_design: each root supplies one novel antipodal direction per ecology; each direction is crossed with both complementary independently randomized stable good odor identities, with shared side orientations and receipt flips within the complement pair
runtime: unmodified dense one-contact core.step, own view, unit write amplitude; all donor weights, support, biases and activity persist across every problem; primitive only for matched protected donor
payload: only incoming writer rows including true connectivity flags, weights and biases, expressed as the changes from a bitwise identical receiver birth; all receiver activity starts at rest
numeric_scramble: preserve intact final support and full numeric delta L2; shuffle bounded numeric increments among compatible active addresses in each writer row and among writer biases; any draw with no feasible change is retained and counted
disconnected_transplants: retain in the assigned arm with no repair; report overall and stratified descriptive sensitivity if any
measurement: actual argmax action, after zero or exactly the specified number of chosen-side receipts, against latent stable good odor; no teacher action; given side can be reported with physical noise
primary_endpoints: 512 writer minus birth_null mean gain after 1, 2, 4 receipts relative to zero
512 minus 8 change in the writer-minus-null gain
512 writer minus numeric_scramble mean gain after 1, 2, 4 receipts relative to zero
positive_decision_rule: all three prespecified signed marginal 95% interval lower bounds exceed zero; show the individual intervals and every dose regardless
secondary: controlled next-edit replay on matched cold action with true selected-side receipt versus zero, checking applied weights, bias and support separately for body and writer
donor action and executed edits, structural connectivity and saturation

bootstrap.method: crossed independent root bootstrap preserving all paired contrasts, no contact-level resampling

exclusions: none; fixed checkpoint step and every root remain even if no changes occur, the graph disconnects on transfer, or acquisition fails
